reason: A named precondition in the prediction body has been publicly retracted and neither the reasoning nor the body records it. The summary opens on 'Qualcomm's roughly $14B full-stack bet this week' built from three legs, one of which is 'reported $8-10B Tenstorrent talks'. On 2026-06-30, reiterated into 2026-07-03, Tenstorrent CEO Jim Keller publicly denied the $8-10B Qualcomm buyout and reaffirmed an independent IPO-bridge and confidential-S-1 path (carried in report/en/news-20260703.md and the surrounding FP files). The ~$14B figure and the Tenstorrent leg are therefore both wrong as stated. reasoning_because survives on its own terms because it cites only the $3.92B Modular deal, but the body a reader sees does not. Rewrite to rescope the trigger to the Modular acquisition alone and to record that the consolidation path the thesis assumed for Tenstorrent was rejected in favour of independence. Not a repeat: 6095c8 was judged all-fresh on 2026-07-12, which post-dates the denial, so this was missed rather than deferred.
